senses.gloss: אִתְּפַח, Ithpa. אִתַּפַּח (v. נְפַח; cmp. נשם) to breathe, rest; to get well, recover.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 30b:6">B. Mets. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>אותבנהו וקא מִיתְּפַח</he> he put the bundles down and rested.
<cite ref="Berakhot 46a:1">Ber. 46ᵃ</cite> <he>אי מִתְּפַח קטינא וכ׳</he> if Ḳ. … recovers, I will make a feast for &c.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 87a">B. Mets. 87ᵃ</cite> <he>עד אלישׁע</he> … <he>דחליש וא׳ וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) until Elisha’s days nobody was ever sick and recovered; then Elisha came and prayed, and he recovered; (Ms. F. <he>לא הוה איקצורי ואִיתַּפּוּחֵי</he> there was no such a thing as being sick and recovering; <he>בעי … למיחלש ואיתפוחי</he> Elisha prayed for sickness and recovery); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 105">Yalk. Gen. 105</cite>.
